verdict: Meta's revenue rose 24% to $59.9B on strong ads, and profit grew 9% to $22.8B even as total costs jumped 40% on its AI build-out.

segments.name: Advertising
segments.note: Ads across Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp and Messenger: impressions grew 18% and the average price per ad rose 6%.

segments.name: Family of Apps other revenue
segments.note: WhatsApp business messaging, Meta Verified subscriptions and other app income; up 54% YoY.

segments.name: Reality Labs
segments.note: Quest headsets and AI glasses; sales fell 12% and the unit lost $6.0B at the operating level.

opex.name: Research & development
opex.note: AI research (Meta Superintelligence Labs), engineers and Reality Labs development; up 41% YoY.

opex.name: Marketing & sales
opex.note: Selling ads and marketing Meta's apps and devices.

otherDetail: Meta reports one combined line, interest and other income (expense), net; this quarter it was a $609M net gain.
follow100Note: The rows may not add exactly due to rounding.

takeaways.title: Ads kept growing fast
takeaways.text: Advertising revenue rose 24% to $58.1B: ad impressions grew 18% and the average price per ad rose 6%. The Family of Apps earned $30.8B of operating profit.

takeaways.title: Reality Labs losses widened
takeaways.text: Reality Labs lost $6.0B at the operating level on $955M of revenue, which fell 12%. Across 2025 the unit lost $19.2B; Meta expects similar losses in 2026.

takeaways.title: The AI bill keeps climbing
takeaways.text: Capital spending was $22.1B in the quarter ($72.2B for 2025), and free cash flow was $14.1B. For 2026 Meta plans capex of $115-135B and total expenses of $162-169B.
